title: Juicy Russian Beet Stir-fry
description: A vibrant, whole30-friendly stir‑fry that showcases roasted beetroot and seasonal vegetables, finished on a raclette grill for a smoky finish. Perfect for a fresh, spring brunch.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high and lightly oil the grill pan.
Toss the beet slices, cabbage, carrot, pepper, and onion with olive oil, ginger, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on the grill pan and cook for 4 minutes, then flip and cook the other side for another 4 minutes.
After the vegetables are slightly charred, add lemon juice and a sprinkle of dill, stirring to combine.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the vegetables to soften.
Remove the pan from heat and transfer the stir‑fry to a serving dish.
Garnish with extra dill if desired, and serve immediately while still warm.
Enjoy this fresh, springy brunch dish with a side of crusty rye or a simple green salad.
